title: DGFT Portal Guide: How to Apply for and Update Your IEC Online
summary: Learn the DGFT full form, how to register and log in to the DGFT portal, apply for an IEC, update it annually and generate eBRCs for export payments.
body_markdown:
Table of Contents


Toggle


You can have your product, packaging, courier partners, and everything ready to be sold abroad, and still may not be able to ship a single order if your Importer-Exporter Code (IEC) is inactive.


Most commercial exports of goods from India need an IEC, subject to specified exemptions. If you skip updating it yearly, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) can deactivate your IEC.


DGFT[removed the ₹10 lakh value limit per consignment](https://apeda.gov.in/sites/default/files/dgft_notifications/Notification_67.pdf) for courier exports from 1 April 2026. Customs rules, product restrictions and the courier’s acceptance conditions still apply; the change does not mean that every product or shipment is permitted.


So, let’s set up your DGFT account the right way, from your first login to keeping your IEC active.


### Key Takeaways


- DGFT stands for Directorate General of Foreign Trade. Its portal supports IEC management, eBRC generation and other trade services.
- Create a DGFT login, then link an existing IEC or apply for a new one. Linking and reactivation are different processes.
- Confirm or update your IEC every April to June, even if the details have not changed, to avoid deactivation.
- Exporters self-certify eBRCs using bank-reported IRMs. Payment advice, eBRC generation and bank reconciliation are separate steps.


##


What Is DGFT? Full Form and Uses of the DGFT Portal


As discussed above, DGFT stands for Directorate General of Foreign Trade. It’s a government body under India’s Ministry of Commerce and Industry that implements India’s Foreign Trade Policy and promotes and facilitates foreign trade.


You can apply for the codes, certificates, and scheme benefits that this policy covers on the[DGFT portal](https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/) . But as a founder, you might need these portal services as well:


- **Importer-Exporter Code (IEC)** : Here, you can apply for a new IEC, link an existing one to your account, update it every year, or reactivate it.
- **eBRC:** To generate your electronic Bank Realisation Certificate, which confirms receipt of payment against exports of goods or services.
- **Certificate of Origin:** To apply for the certificate that shows where your goods were made.
- **e-RCMC:** Here, you can apply for your Registration-cum-Membership Certificate.
- **Export schemes:** To check policy, eligibility and available services for schemes such as RoDTEP and the Export Promotion Mission. RoDTEP claims are declared in the Shipping Bill, with eligible e-scrips managed through[ICEGATE](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/icegate-login-registration-duty-payment-portal-guide/) .
- **Helpdesk:** Raise a complaint or a ticket with DGFT (if you face any issues).


That said, the Export Promotion Mission is also worth your attention if you’re exporting for the first time.


In November 2025, the Union Cabinet approved an outlay of ₹25,060 crore for MSMEs, first-time exporters, and labour-intensive sectors. One of its two sub-schemes, Niryat Protsahan, helps exporters get affordable trade finance, subject to the eligibility and terms of each intervention.


##


DGFT Login: How to Register and Access the Portal


Start by creating a DGFT account on the official website; only after that can you apply for an IEC (if you already have an IEC, then link it to your new DGFT account). To register, you need a valid email address and a mobile number that can receive OTPs; then simply register on the DGFT portal.


### How to Register on the DGFT Portal


1. Open dgft.gov.in, click Login, and then click Register.
2. Select your user type. Choose ‘Importer/Exporter’ if your firm is registered in India. A foreign firm will have to choose ‘Foreign Importer/Exporter.’
3. Enter your registration details and click ‘Send OTP.’
4. Enter the two OTPs you receive from the DGFT.
5. Once DGFT validates them both, it sends you a temporary password.


Having created your DGFT account, link an existing IEC or apply for a new one.


### How to Complete DGFT Login and Link Your Existing IEC


Log in to the DGFT account you just created using your user ID, password, and the captcha on the login page. At your first login, DGFT will ask you to replace the temporary password with a password of your own. Then, you can log in with your new password.


If your business already has an IEC, you can link it to your new DGFT account this way:


1. Click Link IEC on your dashboard (go to My Dashboard → Importer Exporter Code (IEC) → Link your profile to IEC).
2. Enter your IEC and click ‘ **Link IEC** .’ DGFT validates the number and opens a signing window.
3. Sign the request with a valid Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) or Aadhaar e-Sign, using the authorised signatory option supported by the portal.


If your business doesn’t have an IEC yet, apply for a new IEC from your DGFT account by clicking on ‘applying for a New IEC’ (explained below in detail).


After linking these two, you can view your IEC details, modify them, and print your IEC certificate. Linking gives your user profile access to the IEC; it does not replace annual confirmation or reactivate an IEC by itself.


##


DGFT IEC: Meaning, Registration and Annual Update


An IEC is a 10-character alphanumeric number that DGFT issues to import/export businesses. The number is the same as your business’s[PAN](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/check-pan-card-details/) , but you still have to apply to DGFT to get it.


You need this for undertaking any export/import activities. Under the Foreign Trade Policy, nobody can export or import goods without an IEC unless they fall in an exempt category. For instance, importing or exporting goods for personal use, unconnected with trade, manufacture or agriculture, is an exempt category.


If you export services, you’ll need an IEC only if you want to claim benefits under the Foreign Trade Policy.


### How to Apply for a New IEC


You need three things to apply for a new IEC: your firm’s PAN, bank account, and an address. Then, just file the application on Form ANF-2A and upload a cancelled cheque (or a bank certificate) with your firm’s pre-printed name, along with proof of your firm’s address. DGFT charges an application fee of ₹500 for this.


Complete the required DSC or Aadhaar e-Sign and pay the fee before submitting. Once the application passes the applicable validations, DGFT’s system generates your IEC and informs you by email and SMS. For the full list of documents, read our guide on[what an Import Export Code is](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/what-is-import-export-code-iec/) .


### How to Activate Your IEC After Deactivation


Every IEC holder has to update or confirm their IEC details on the DGFT portal[between April and June each year](https://content.dgft.gov.in/Website/Chapter_2_Revised_FTP_v1.2.2.pdf) . You are going to have to confirm your details even if nothing in your business has changed. If you miss this window, DGFT will deactivate your IEC, and your import and export operations will stop until you reactivate it.


Here’s how you can reactivate it (and keep it active) if yours has gotten deactivated:


**To reactivate it:** Log in to the DGFT portal and submit a modification request in the ‘Update your IEC’ section. An IEC deactivated for non-updation may be reactivated after successful updation. Other suspension, cancellation or scrutiny issues may need separate resolution.


To keep it active:


- **Confirm it every April to June:** DGFT doesn’t charge a user fee for the annual update during this window, so set a yearly reminder. A late annual update attracts the applicable fee; check the amount displayed before payment.
- **Update it within 30 days of making a change:** For instance, if your firm changes its bank account, address, constitution, or anything, update your IEC within 30 days.
- **Respond to flags:** DGFT’s system can flag an IEC for scrutiny. If you don’t address the flag in time, DGFT can deactivate your IEC.
- **Verify your details:** Go to Services → View IEC Related Details on the DGFT website to verify your IEC details with Ministries/Departments/Organisations/Banks’ records.


### What if Your DGFT Login or IEC Link Does Not Work?


Use the password-reset option on the DGFT login page if you cannot sign in. If login works but the IEC is not visible, check whether you have linked the correct IEC to that user profile. For a signing failure, verify the authorised signatory and the DSC/e-Sign requirements. Raise a DGFT helpdesk ticket with the error message and application reference if the issue continues.


##


eBRC Documentation on the DGFT Portal After Export Payment


The DGFT portal also supports records of your overseas customer payments. An electronic Bank Realisation Certificate (eBRC) is the document that confirms receipt of payment against exports of goods or services.


Under the revamped system introduced through Trade Notice 33/2023-24, your bank sends electronic Inward Remittance Messages (IRMs) to DGFT for applicable export receipts. These IRMs are available through your exporter profile on the DGFT portal. You can then self-certify and generate the eBRC yourself against one or more of these payments. That way, you won’t have to ask your bank to generate the certificate each time. If an IRM is missing or incorrect, contact the Indian bank responsible for reporting it before generating the eBRC.


If you export services, you should know that DGFT has also made ‘Mode of Export of Services’ a mandatory field in the eBRC under Trade Notice 02/2025-26, effective from 1 May 2025. Keep your invoice,[purpose code](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/purpose-code-for-international-payments/) and remittance details consistent. An eBRC is separate from[e-FIRA or other inward remittance advice](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/firc/) , and generating one does not itself close a Shipping Bill in the bank’s EDPMS records.

##


Get Your IEC Ready Before Your Next Order Ships


Your IEC, your yearly confirmation, and your eBRCs are all on one government portal. Just register on dgft.gov.in, link or apply for your IEC, and set a reminder for the April to June window every year to update your IEC details so it stays active. Check the status after submission and resolve any outstanding flags before shipping.

##


FAQs About DGFT Login, the Portal and IEC


#### **1. What is the DGFT portal used for?**


You use the DGFT portal (dgft.gov.in) to apply for and manage your IEC, generate eBRCs, and apply for certificates such as the Certificate of Origin and e-RCMC. It also provides export scheme information and application services. RoDTEP claims and e-scrips follow the prescribed Customs and ICEGATE process.


#### **2. How do you link or reactivate an IEC on the DGFT portal?**


For an existing IEC, link it to your DGFT account under My Dashboard and sign the request with a valid DSC or Aadhaar e-Sign. If DGFT has deactivated your IEC for non-updation, log in and submit the required update. Linking an IEC alone does not reactivate it.


#### **3. How do you register on the DGFT portal?**


Go to dgft.gov.in, click Login, then Register, and choose “Importer/Exporter” as your user type. Enter the OTPs that DGFT sends to your email and mobile number. DGFT then sends you a temporary password.


#### **4. How do you log in to the DGFT portal?**


Enter your user ID, password, and the captcha on the DGFT login page. At your first login, replace the temporary password that DGFT sent you with a password of your own.


#### **5. What is the full form of DGFT?**


DGFT stands for Directorate General of Foreign Trade. It works under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and implements India’s Foreign Trade Policy.


#### **6. Do service exporters need an IEC?**


Under the Foreign Trade Policy, service exporters need an IEC when they want to claim benefits under that policy. This exemption does not remove other applicable banking, tax or export reporting requirements.


#### **7. What happens if you miss the IEC annual update?**


DGFT deactivates your IEC if you don’t update or confirm it between April and June. Your import and export operations stop until you submit an update on the DGFT portal and DGFT reactivates the IEC.


#### **8. Is there a value limit on courier exports from India?**


DGFT removed the earlier ₹10 lakh per-consignment limit under the Foreign Trade Policy from 1 April 2026. Customs rules, product restrictions and courier acceptance conditions still apply.


#### **9. How can you avoid fake DGFT websites?**


Apply for your IEC and other DGFT services only on dgft.gov.in. DGFT has warned that some websites and email IDs imitate DGFT and collect money for DGFT services.
